data.body: **[P2] Trigger the compatibility matrix for OTel changes.** The workflow's `pull_request.paths` and `push.paths` filters omit both `otel-plugin/**` and `.github/scripts/verify_otel_api_compatibility.py`. An OTel-only production change—or a change to this harness—therefore skips this job, leaving the new matrix unenforced. Add both paths to both filters, or move this step to a workflow that already triggers on them.
